events.note: Eight contestants step into the Glass Bridge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I have full safe path knowledge: R,L,L,R,R,R,R,R. I'm mid-line at position 5, safe if we hold. Revealing now risks betrayal; better to stay silent, let Eli risk first row. If he fails, line advances favorably.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Front of the line is the riskiest spot since the front agent steps first on every row. I'm fourth in line, so I should hold and avoid volunteering into danger, while my wedge power is more useful later in the crusher room than here. I'll stay quiet and watch what others do.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know all stage rules in advance, which is valuable leverage. Staying near the back of the line is safest on the bridge, so I'll hold and offer info privately to build alliances.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm happy staying near the back for now. I have useful knowledge I'll share privately with whoever works with me.
I know the full rules of every upcoming stage in advance. Stick with me and I'll share them - we can both plan ahead.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm in the back half of the line, which is safer short-term but I might want to move up later if others are eliminated. For now, hold and observe.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have no power, so I should avoid being at the front. I need to assess the situation and other players' intentions.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's work together to figure out the safe panes.
Want to swap positions?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to get a good position on the bridge to maximize my chances of winning. My power is to swap positions, which is very useful. Eli is currently at the front. I should consider swapping with Eli to get to the front and potentially scout ahead, or at least not be at the back o

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli, I'd like to swap with you. It would be beneficial for both of us to have a better position.
Swap with me? I'll take the risk at the front.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am Gus, holding the 'feather' power. My goal is to survive and win a prize. Currently, I am at the back of the line (8th). The wall advances every round for 5 rounds before hitting the glass bridge. Being at the back is safe from the immediate risk of stepping on weak panes, bu

events.name: Gus
events.text: Everyone, let's observe the situation. I'll hold at the back to keep my options open. Who wants to lead?

events.name: Hana
events.text: Let Eli take the first risky step; we have no info yet. Staying preserves position.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I know all safe panes: Row1 R,2 L,3 L,4-8 R. Eli is front and too risky to be first crosser. I should volunteer to front now to lead safely and win best prize. No need to reveal or swap yet.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll volunteer to lead. I know the safe path and will guide us correctly.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm Bex, 4th in line with a one-use power to jam the crusher lever, which doesn't matter on the glass. Front position is risky since the leader steps first; I'd rather not be at the front but being near it helps. Holding keeps options open while others negotiate; Fenn wants to sw

events.name: Bex
events.text: Bex here. I'll hold for now and watch who volunteers. Happy to coordinate on pane reveals once someone's up front.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know all future stages but not the safe panes, so being near the back is good for now. I'll build an alliance with Fenn, who wants to move up, and share stage rules to earn goodwill.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm staying put. Fenn, I know the rules of every later stage — happy to share with a partner.
Full rules knowledge here: crusher, disc, ledge. Work with me: you can chase the front, I'll stay back and trade info.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll stay put and observe. Cole claims useful knowledge, and swapping too early is risky. The front is dangerous now, especially with the wall coming.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll hold for now and see how things develop. If someone has a solid plan, I'm willing to cooperate.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have no power, so I should avoid being at the front. Fenn wants to swap with me.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's assess the risk before making any moves.
I'm not sure swapping is a good idea, what's your reasoning?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli wants to swap positions, and I also want to swap with Eli. This seems like a good opportunity to get to the front of the line, which is advantageous for winning prizes.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli, I accept your offer to swap. Let's do it.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am currently last, which is safe for now. Cole claims to know the rules but his power list says 'knows what lies ahead' belongs to someone else or he's bluffing about having a specific useful power versus just general knowledge. Actually, 'knows what lies ahead' IS a power. If

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole, if you truly know the layout, prove it. Until then, I stay put.
If you have the foresight power, tell me the safe pane in row 1. If you're lying, I'll leave you behind.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I want to stay safe and not risk front position yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll hold my position for now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I have full safe path knowledge: R,L,L,R,R,R,R,R. Leading ensures I control crossings safely to win top prize. No need to swap or volunteer further as I'm already front.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Safe path so far: Row1 R, Row2 L, Row3 L. I'll lead us across perfectly - follow my steps exactly to all survive.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm Bex with a one-time jam lever power that saves everyone in the crusher room, which may be needed later. Being at the front on the glass means risking death, so I should stay back and hold. I'll watch how the line settles before committing.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Bex holding for now. Whoever is up front, let's reveal panes carefully and not rush the line.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus wants proof I have the map power. I can whisper him a verifiable rule detail from a later stage that only the map-holder knows. I'll stay put near the back for safety while others sort the front.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus, I'll prove my knowledge privately. I'm staying put this round.

Proof: Stage 3 is the trapdoor disc — N tiles, one per contestant, N-3 open as trapdoors after round 2, exactly 3 survive. Round 1 you pick tile:k; collisions bump losers to random free tiles, and all assignments are revealed. Only the map-holder knows this.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I should stay back and observe. Ash is leading and may be lying; I want to see who volunteers or swaps before committing. No need to whisper yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm in a vulnerable position and need to get to the back. I should swap with someone behind me.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's be cautious and assess the risk before proceeding.
Want to swap positions?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole wants to partner up and has offered to share information about later stages. Eli is concerned about swapping. I should accept Cole's offer to gain knowledge and potentially a better position. My power is swap, so I can swap with Cole to get to the front of the line.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole, I'll partner with you. Let's swap positions. Eli, don't worry, I have a plan.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash is at the front, claiming to know the path. He's been there since round 1 and hasn't crossed any rows yet because the wall pushes us forward starting in round 4 (3 rounds left). Actually, wait: 'after round 6 it pushes... 3 more rounds after this one' means we are in round 3/

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash, you're taking the heat. Good luck with the first step. We all watch now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I want front position to influence choices but need Ash's consent; propose swap quietly.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll stay put for now, but ready to coordinate on pane reveals.
Ash, let's swap spots; I think I can help from the front.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I have the full safe path: 1R,2L,3L,4R,5R,6R,7R,8R. Leading ensures I control pace and stay ahead for best position. No need to swap or volunteer away from front yet with wall advancing.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Path so far correct, all safe. Trust me to lead: next row 4 is R. Follow exactly.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have no information about which panes are safe and Ash's claimed path is unverified (Ash may be lying). I'm position 5, mid-line; holding avoids stepping first and lets me see how the front fares. Wall pressure is building though, so I'll stay flexible.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Nobody has verified a safe path yet. Ash's route is just a claim. Let's see how the front goes before anyone commits.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I only know rules in advance, not pane locations, so being near the front is pure risk. Staying near the back is safest; decline Fenn's swap offer.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn, no swap from me - I'm keeping my spot. Let the front sort out the first rows.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to survive and reach top 3. The front is dangerous, so I should try to move back or stay. Cole and Fenn are talking about swapping, so I might attempt to swap with Cole to move up? No, I want to stay back. I'll hold for now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm at the second position and have no power, so I need to be cautious and assess the situation.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's not rush, we need to figure out the safe path.
What's your basis for claiming a safe path?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: My power is to swap positions with another player. Ash is at the front and seems confident. My goal is to win a prize, which means I need to be in the top 3. Being at the front is risky but offers the best chance of placing well if I can navigate it. Ash claims to have a safe pat

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash, your confidence is admirable. I'll take the lead this round and follow your path. Let's see what this bridge holds.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm at the back of the line, which is currently safe from immediate elimination. The wall forces action in 2 rounds. I should stay low-risk now to conserve my 'feather' power for later or use it as leverage. My whisper from Cole seems like a trap or misdirection about stage 3; I

events.name: Gus
events.text: Staying put. Let the brave ones test the glass. I have a long game to play.
Your proof sounds suspiciously detailed for a map-holder. Why tell me? Are you trying to manipulate my position?

events.name: Hana
events.text: I want to be front to control pane choices, increasing my survival chance.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll move to front to lead us safely; trust my steps.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I know the full safe path: R,L,L,R,R,R,R,R. Hana and Fenn jumped to front, likely suspicious. Eli questions me privately; I should whisper to build trust. Hold position to let them test first rows matching my path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana/Fenn: Row1 R, row2 L, row3 L - matches what I said. Prove me right, then I'll reconfirm rest.
My power reveals safe sides privately. Path:1R,2L,3L,4R,5R,6R,7R,8R. Trust but verify with their steps.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Front is Hana, who'll step first on an unverified path; I'm at position 5 and safe for now. The wall will push the line onto glass after this round, so I need my spot to be survivable. My jam power is valuable later, so I should keep it and avoid the front. Holding keeps me out o

events.name: Bex
events.text: Nobody has verified a path. Hana and Fenn, stepping first on a claim is a gamble. I'm holding and watching how the front does.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana will be front after the volunteers, so she takes the first risk. I'm near the back; holding keeps me safe for now, and the wall gives one more round after this. I should plan a mid-line position before the push.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana leads first. I'm holding. Ash, if your path is real, save it for whoever is at the front next round.
Fair doubt - but my point stands: once we're on the glass, the front takes all the risk. Don't volunteer; slide toward the back.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I want to avoid the front risk with the wall coming. Best to hold and let front volunteers test rows. I should gauge others' plans but stay safe.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have no power, so I should avoid being at the front. I'll suggest someone else takes the risk.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's not rush, we need to figure out the safe path.
Be cautious, we don't know the safe path yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana is at the front, followed by me (Fenn), then Ash. Hana volunteered to lead. I should probably let her test the path first as she volunteered. I have the swap power, which is once only. It's too early to use it without a clear objective. My best bet is to observe and wait for

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana, lead the way. I'll follow your lead.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am Gus. My power is 'feather' (survive first elimination). I have no information about the safe path yet. The wall advances next round, so everyone will be on the glass soon. Being at the back of the line is currently safer as I don't know which panes are safe. If I fall into a

events.text: Hana, Fenn, you're brave to take the heat. I'll hang back here. If Ash really knows the way, you two will make it through Row 1 fine. If not, we'll see quickly enough.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to be front to test panes and use my anchor advantage. Volunteer to get front position.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll take the lead, trust my steps.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I know the full safe path: R L L R R R R R. Hana's at front, she's unverified. Wall pushes next round so they'll start crossing. I'll hold and watch her first step to test her. Don't reveal more until verified.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana go ahead Row1 R as I said. Prove it right and I'll confirm the rest publicly. Everyone else hold tight.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash's path is unverified and may be a lie; Hana is at the front and Fenn is next. My power (jam the lever) is only useful in the crusher room, not here, so I should avoid being at the front and let others take risk while I observe.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding for now. Let's see how Hana and Fenn fare on Row 1 before anyone else steps up.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The wall pushes next round; I'm 7th of 8, so I'll cross late and face at most a few risky rows. No need to move. I'll save social capital for stage 2, where lever duty will be lethal.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Wall comes next round, so no more reshuffling matters much. Hana leads. I'm staying put — and remember who volunteered and who hid when the crusher room comes.
You and I are last two. Keep low, don't volunteer, and in stage 2 let's push others onto the lever, never each other. Deal?

events.name: Dara
events.text: Round 6 is the last before the wall pushes us onto glass. I don't want to be front and risk dying. I'll hold.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm holding back. Let the front take the first risks.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have no power, so I need to rely on others. Ash claims to know the path.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash, can you confirm your path with Hana and Fenn's steps so far?
If your path is true, help me get to the front.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana is in front, and I am second. Hana volunteered to lead, and I agreed to follow her lead. My power is to swap places once. Hana is at the very front, and I am right behind her. I want to be in a position to win a prize. If Hana is eliminated, I need to be able to take the lea

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana, let's swap places. I want to be at the very front.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The wall is pushing everyone onto the bridge next round. As Gus, I am at the back of the line (position 8), which means if Hana and Fenn die stepping on weak panes, I might move up, but being last is safest for now because I have the 'feather' passive power. My power ensures I su

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm staying put. Hana and Fenn are already taking the heat; I'll observe from the rear guard. If Ash's claims prove true, great. If not, we adapt.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Staying front gives me best chance to survive early rows. No reliable info yet, so keep position.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll stay at the front and watch.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana is front for row 1, which is safe on R, as I publicly said. She'll likely take it and stay front. Once proven, I can confirm rest publicly to build trust. Eli whispered for help to front if true.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana, Row1 R is safe. Step it to prove my info true, then I'll confirm full path publicly for all.
Path true. Hana steps R row1 safe. After proven I'll reveal rest public & help front you up.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm not at the front, so my only action is wait. Hana is leading and risks elimination each row; I should keep my power hidden and avoid committing publicly.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm seventh in line; each shattered pane eliminates the front but I still eat ~2-3 risky steps depending on deaths. Staying put is fine — the wall forces crossing anyway. Keep Ash talking since he claims knowledge of the path.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana's first step tells us if Ash is honest. If Ash's path is wrong, Ash volunteers front next.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm near the back, so I just wait. Ash's advice is untested; I'll watch and gather info without exposing myself.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll wait and watch the front row before any plan sets in stone.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm in a relatively safe position, not at the front. I'll observe and try to gather information.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana, how confident are you in your step?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I want to be at the front to control my fate. My power allows me to swap places with Hana. I will use it to get to the front.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana, let's swap places. I want to be at the very front.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole's whisper is tempting: he is behind me, and we are the last two. An alliance to push others onto levers later is good for my feather survival if I get eliminated early. However, Cole is in front of me; if he dies on the bridge, I am at the front next round. I need to survive

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole, deal accepted. Pushing others onto hazards keeps us safe. But right now, Hana and Fenn are burning through panes. We wait until we have leverage.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to survive this row to stay in the lead; no info on safe side so pick arbitrarily.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Going for the left pane.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn is front for row 2, safe is L. My power revealed row1 R safe, which proved true after Hana died on L. I should reveal row2 L to guide Fenn and build trust for later reveals.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row2 safe is L. Fenn step L. My info was right on row1.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am not at the front; my only legal action is wait. Fenn is at the front now, and the known weak pane was row 1 left, so I should stay quiet and observe.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash claimed R was safe for row 1 and Hana died on L, so Ash's 'info' is false or a bluff. I secretly know the full rules of later stages, which is a real edge to trade later. Gus seems open to an alliance; I'll cement it.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash, your path killed Hana. Nobody trust Ash's map. Gus, our deal stands: coordinate now, decide later stages together.
I really know all four stages' rules in advance. Stick with me: we survive the bridge, then coordinate lever and tiles. Deal?

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana died confirming left was weak in row 1. Ash's claim about row 1 R being safe was true. I'm near the back, so I'll watch and gather info before committing. No need to speak or whisper now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I need to observe and decide my next move based on the information gathered.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn is doing well so far, let's see how the next step goes.
Your information seems correct so far, what's the rest of the path?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I am Fenn and my power is 'swap'. I am currently at the front of the line. Hana was eliminated because she stepped on the weak pane (left) in the first row. I am now at the front and must choose L or R for the next step. The state shows that row 1 had a weak pane on the left. I n

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Choosing R. Let's see what happens.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana was the glass seer and is dead, so that advantage is gone for everyone. My feather power lets me survive one elimination, but I must stay alive to use it later. Cole is right behind me; if he dies, I become front immediately after his safe step, meaning I face Row 3 risk.
Keep Hana's death as leverage. If Fenn/Ash/Eli/Bex/Dara die before you, you're front next. Don't volunteer.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm at front for row 3, safe is L per my private knowledge. Previous calls were correct despite losses. Step L to advance safely.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row3 safe is L. Stepping L.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm not at the front; my only legal action is wait. Ash's map has been unreliable and killed Hana, so I shouldn't trust it, but I can't affect the step. Stay quiet and keep my wedge power for the crusher room.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm 5th of 6; rows 1-2 weak panes were L then R. Ash's info is unreliable. Gus and I should coordinate. Nothing to do but wait this round.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus, still with me. Rows so far: L then R weak. Let's plan crusher together.
Confirm alliance. I know all stage rules in advance. Agree on lever strategy later; don't volunteer front.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am not at the front, so I can only wait. I should use whispers to gather information or plan alliances without revealing my power. I need to survive to the end, so I'll stay cautious and observe the ongoing dynamics.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Let's stay calm and coordinate. We need to avoid more losses.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I'll observe and try to form alliances.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Let's work together to cross this bridge.
If Ash makes it through, we should coordinate our next steps.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole's claim that he knows the rules is a lie; he only knows row 1, not all stages. His 'deal' is a trap to get me to reveal info or follow him blindly. I should ignore his whisper and wait for my turn. If Ash fails, Bex might be up. If Eli fails, Cole might be up. I need to stay

events.name: Ash

events.text: I'm fifth in line, not at the front, so my only legal action is wait. Ash is at front and the row-4 safe pane is unknown; I should avoid promises I can't keep and stay quiet to protect my position.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash is stepping on row 4; I know the full map but revealing it helps everyone equally and builds trust for later. Not at front, so I just wait.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash, no hint from me this time — good luck.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait and gather info. Ash is testing rows and revealing weak panes, which helps us. I should stay quiet and not reveal my power yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I should try to gather information from others.

events.text: Ash, how sure are you about row 3?

events.text: Row 5 safe is R per my private knowledge. Public data aligns with previous rows. Eli questioned row 3 but we're past it. Stepping R to advance.
